skill.name: notion-research-documentation
skill.description: Research Notion workspaces, synthesize source material, and create structured documentation with citations and references.
skill.summary: Turn Notion research into cited briefs, summaries, comparisons, and reports.
skill.author: davila7

remediation.suggestion: State clearly that setup connects Codex to the remote Notion MCP service and requires explicit user approval before adding the server.
Require user confirmation before creating or updating Notion pages, especially when multiple destinations or existing pages match.

content.value_statement: Important Notion knowledge is often spread across many pages and databases. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code gather sources and produce cited documentation.
actual_capabilities: Searches Notion with targeted queries and asks for clarification when results are ambiguous.
Fetches relevant Notion pages and extracts facts, metrics, claims, dates, and constraints.
Selects a brief, summary, comparison, or comprehensive report format based on the task.
Synthesizes findings into organized documentation with source links and citation notes.
Creates or updates Notion pages when the Notion MCP connection is available.
limitations: Requires Notion MCP setup and OAuth access before it can search or write Notion content.
Can only access Notion pages and databases granted to the connected account.
Quality depends on the accuracy and completeness of the source pages.
Ambiguous search results may require user confirmation before documentation is created.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Decision Brief
use_cases.description: Collect related Notion pages and produce a short brief with key evidence, risks, and next steps.

use_cases.title: Compare Internal Options
use_cases.description: Summarize tradeoffs from multiple Notion sources and present a clear comparison with citations.

use_cases.title: Build a Research Report
use_cases.description: Turn scattered notes into a structured report that includes findings, gaps, recommendations, and references.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize One Topic
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a short Notion research summary.
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Notion for pages about [topic]. Create a short summary with key points, open questions, and source links.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Decision Brief
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a focused executive brief.
prompt_templates.prompt: Research [decision or initiative] across Notion. Produce a brief with context, findings, risks, recommendation, and cited source pages.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Alternatives
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for evaluating options from internal notes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find Notion pages about [option A], [option B], and [option C]. Compare tradeoffs, evidence quality, owners, timelines, and recommended next steps.

prompt_templates.title: Publish a Comprehensive Report
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for creating a finished Notion document.
prompt_templates.prompt: Research [topic] across Notion, identify contradictions and gaps, then create a comprehensive report page with citations and a short changelog.

output_examples.input: Research the latest customer onboarding notes and summarize what changed this quarter.
output_examples.output: A Notion research summary with key changes, cited source pages, risks, open questions, and suggested follow-up tasks.

output_examples.input: Compare three vendor options stored in our procurement workspace.
output_examples.output: A comparison document with option summaries, tradeoffs, evidence links, recommendation, and unresolved decision points.

output_examples.input: Create an executive-ready report from scattered market research notes.
output_examples.output: A structured report with an overview, major findings, supporting evidence, recommendations, references, and a handoff status note.

best_practices: Define the research question and desired document format before searching Notion.
Confirm ambiguous search results with the user before relying on them as sources.
Keep citations close to claims so readers can inspect the original Notion pages.
anti_patterns: Do not create or update Notion pages before confirming the destination and scope.
Do not treat old or conflicting notes as authoritative without flagging uncertainty.
Do not omit source links when summarizing facts, metrics, claims, or dates.

faq.question: Does this skill require a Notion connection?
faq.answer: Yes. It needs Notion MCP access and OAuth login before it can search, fetch, create, or update pages.

faq.question: Can it create new Notion pages?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow includes creating documentation pages when the Notion MCP tool is connected and the user approves the destination.

faq.question: Does it cite sources?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow tracks source pages and adds citations or reference links to the generated documentation.

faq.question: What document types can it produce?
faq.answer: It supports quick briefs, research summaries, comparisons, and comprehensive reports.

faq.question: Can it search every Notion page?
faq.answer: No. It can only access pages and databases available to the connected Notion account.

faq.question: Is it suitable for sensitive workspace data?
faq.answer: Use workspace access controls carefully. Review sources and destinations before creating or updating pages with sensitive information.
